question: What paradox is stated about one who is wise, even while burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of essence as the means.
A wise person is described as burning.
The particle api marks an emphatic or paradoxical case.
inference: Even a wise person, while burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence, remains the subject of the stated process.
uncertainties: The outcome for the wise person is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence, even the wise person, while burning, still does so.
